nodes.title: The Other Side
nodes.summary: MC emerges from the Fracture injured and disoriented, is discovered by a small civilian/local-escort group already traveling with Julie d’Aubigny, receives Julie's practical aid, learns that Primora and Vaelkrath are unknown, and travels onward with the group before road danger escalates into CH01-B01.

beats.title: Fracture Arrival
beats.screenAction: MC crashes into unfamiliar wooded farmland while still injured from the failed-chimera encounter. The broken starting sword remains with MC. The small Fracture collapses and leaves no obvious trace.
beats.dialogueIntent: Short reaction to pain, disorientation, and unfamiliar surroundings. No cosmology explanation.
beats.result: MC is mobile but still unable to contribute normal attacks.

beats.title: Toward the Road
beats.screenAction: MC gets bearings, checks the unusable broken sword, and moves toward the nearby road.
beats.dialogueIntent: MC still assumes the fall or passage led somewhere unfamiliar within the home world.
beats.result: Voices and a traveling cart/group become noticeable.

beats.title: The Group Finds MC
beats.screenAction: A small traveling group of displaced civilians and local militia/courier escorts discovers MC. Julie is already traveling with them.
beats.dialogueIntent: The escorts are cautious about an unknown injured stranger. Julie notices MC's condition.
beats.result: Ordinary civilians/local escorts become MC's literal first France contact; Julie is the first notable primary character present.

beats.title: Julie Helps
beats.screenAction: Julie approaches the injured MC, checks the wounds, provides or directs immediate aid, and makes clear the group should not abandon an injured stranger simply because the stranger is unknown.
beats.dialogueIntent: Practical compassion rather than a dramatic rescue speech. Julie remains independent, not a formal French-army representative.
beats.result: Julie becomes the first notable person in France to personally choose to help MC.

beats.title: Foreign Words
beats.screenAction: Conversation continues while MC notices the group's speech sounds foreign even though the meaning is understood. MC answers in their own language and is understood in return.
beats.dialogueIntent: Confirm the spoken-language anomaly naturally. Nobody explains its cause.
beats.result: The approved cross-world spoken-language rule is experienced directly.

beats.title: Primora and Vaelkrath
beats.screenAction: MC gives their player-selected name and identifies Primora Village and Vaelkrath as home references. Nobody in the group recognizes either name.
beats.dialogueIntent: The locals are genuinely unfamiliar with the names; Julie does not ridicule or accuse MC.
beats.result: MC gains the first strong contradiction while still assuming an unfamiliar distant region rather than another world.

beats.title: Orléans
beats.screenAction: The group continues along the road with MC included. Conversation naturally introduces Orléans, the English siege, and Charles/the Dauphin within the Loire-war context.
beats.dialogueIntent: Give enough historical context for player recognition to precede MC recognition without turning the scene into an exposition lecture.
beats.result: Orléans becomes a practical source of information and supplies rather than a political commitment.

beats.title: Stay With Us
beats.screenAction: Julie makes it clear that wandering off alone while injured is unsafe and supports keeping MC with the traveling group until treatment and information are available.
beats.dialogueIntent: MC accepts for treatment, safety, information, and a route toward answers about home—not because of allegiance to France.
beats.result: MC has a believable temporary place with Julie and the civilian group.

beats.title: Trouble Ahead
beats.screenAction: The traveling group detects armed trouble on the road ahead and the journey is interrupted.
beats.dialogueIntent: Keep the escalation immediate and practical; this is the handoff into the first mandatory France battle.
beats.result: Load CH01-B01 — Strangers on the Road.

nodes.title: Strangers on the Road
nodes.summary: First mandatory France battle. Protect/escort the civilian group and supply cart from armed foragers/stragglers while MC remains attack-limited. Julie is already present; Hangaku Gozen and La Hire are the next notable named introductions.

nodes.title: Shelter Before Nightfall
nodes.summary: Post-B01 shelter, treatment, food and rest. A cheap replacement weapon is obtained only after this recovery period.

nodes.title: Names That Should Mean Nothing
nodes.summary: Recovery and context deepen the contradiction: Primora and Vaelkrath remain unknown while Orléans becomes the practical route toward information.

nodes.title: The Road to Orléans
nodes.summary: Combat climax against an organized English siege-line road detachment/outer screen. The sequence progresses through approach/passage, opening the cordon/freeing detainees, and escape before reinforcements. MC restores basic Attack when using the cheap replacement sword to protect someone in immediate danger.

nodes.title: The Maid Is Coming
nodes.summary: Chapter resolution. Jeanne remains physically offscreen; conflicting rumors establish that the Maid is coming while MC's practical route remains Orléans and the search for answers.
